title: Evening prioritize: pipeline triage + call list (Jules)
content:
Quick brain dump / evening triage for tomorrow — lightweight, no polished copy.

TODAY:
- 28 dials, 9 conversations. 2 demos scheduled (BrightFleet, NovaLedger).
- Major win: got verbal buy-in from FolioPay buyer (legal loop next week).
- Lost: KiteHealth went with competitor — notes saved under GH-3412.

PRIORITY BUCKETS (ranked):
1) Demo follow-ups (send recap + calendar invite + short ROI slide)
   - BrightFleet (Thu 10am PT) -> send tailored ROI bullets, ask for tech contact
   - NovaLedger (Fri 2pm PT) -> include perf numbers for 16k tokens/day workload
2) Warm prospects to convert to demo (aim 2 demos/day)
   - Arcadia Retail (head of data) -> priority: show latency/cost tradeoffs
3) Quick re-engage (email + 1 call)
   - FolioPay (legal) -> check contract questions, propose simple SOW template
4) Nurture / low-touch -> add to monthly cadence, tag "Q3-pipeline"

CALL LIST (order = A -> C priority):
A1 BrightFleet - Elena M. (Head of ML Ops) — notes: cares about SLOs and burst capacity. Use one-liner: "We keep LLM latency predictable when traffic spikes." Ask: current avg 95p latency?
A2 NovaLedger - Samir P. (CTO) — notes: interested in private deployment (on-prem). Bring up Redwood Private + KMS. Follow-up: send architecture sketch.
A3 Arcadia Retail - Marla (Head of Data Eng) — notes: curious about caching/kv strategies. Offer A/B rollout idea.
B1 FolioPay - Legal (TBD) — status: buyer verbal. Action: email SOW stub + next steps.
B2 KiteHealth - reject debrief -> quick learnings: pricing pushback on per-token model, missed demo timing.
C1 Prospect: Lumina Agency (inbound) — schedule intro call.

CALL FRAME (30s hook -> 2 Qs -> next step):
- Hook: "We help teams keep LLM inference under predictable latency while cutting serving cost 20-50%."
- Q1: "What are your latency SLOs and how much variability do you see?"
- Q2: "Do you prefer hosted API or private infra for compliance?"
- Close: "If it makes sense I can book a 30-min convo with our solutions engineer to map to your infra."

EMAIL TEMPLATES (short):
- Subject: Quick follow-up + 2 slides on latency + cost (BrightFleet)
  Body blurb: "Hey Elena — great to chat. Attached 2 slides: 95p latency for burst + cost delta vs naive serving. Quick Q: who on your infra team should I loop in?"

- Subject: Demo confirmation — NovaLedger
  Body blurb: "Samir, confirmed Fri 2pm PT. Attendees: you, me, Marco (solutions). Agenda: 1) perf targets 2) infra options 3) rollout plan. Link: <calendar>"

BLOCKERS / TO DO TOMORROW:
- Get legal SOW template from Kira (Slack ping) -> needed for FolioPay close.
- Send architecture sketch to Samir (use GH-3412 notes).
- Quick checklist to handoff demos to Marco: recording permission, test prompt set, perf target doc.

NOTES TO SELF:
- Leave 2x 45-min demo blocks open (10-11:15, 1:30-3) for deep-dive days.
- Track conversion reasons in sheet: col B = "why moved to demo".
- When prospect asks about quantization/precision, default to "our Optimize recommends quant profile per workload" and offer a live eval.

FOLLOW-UPS (ASAP):
- Send BrightFleet recap + invite (before 8am PT)
- Email FolioPay SOW to legal contact (after Kira confirms)
- Add Lumina Agency to demo queue + propose Tue slot

REMINDERS:
- Update weekly leader board (sheet) before EOD Friday.
- Share 1 short win in #wins on Mon.

Open questions:
- Who owns billing for NovaLedger PO (reassign if needed)? -> ask Kira.
- Should we start a "demo-templates" folder in Drive? quick win for SDRs.

Random scratch ideas for playbook:
- 1-pager: "When to push Dedicated vs Hosted" with 3 customer archetypes. (Draft later)
- Rapid A/B: test subject lines with and without numbers ("20% cost" vs "predictable latency").

End of notes. Tidy when I have 10–15m tomorrow AM.

Jules M.
